title: Marked deformation categories and tangent spaces under finite residue-field extension
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $S=\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and $k$ a field of finite type as an $R$-algebra [def-weil-field, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Use schemes and universes of [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathcal Y$ be a category fibred in groupoids over $S$-schemes: each fibre $\mathcal Y(T)$ is a groupoid, with pullbacks along base morphisms and coherent identity and composition comparisons. Assume that for every pushout $T'=T\amalg_Z Z'$ of spectra of Artinian local rings of finite type over $S$, with $Z\to Z'$ a closed immersion defined by a nilpotent ideal, restriction is an equivalence $\mathcal Y(T')\simeq\mathcal Y(T)\times_{\mathcal Y(Z)}\mathcal Y(Z')$, where the right side retains the specified isomorphism over $Z$. For $y\in\mathcal Y(\operatorname{Spec}k)$ define $\mathcal F_y(A)$, on $\mathcal C_{R,k}$ of [def-sfb-artin-deformation-test-category], to be the groupoid of pairs $(\eta,\alpha:\eta|_k\xrightarrow{\sim}y)$, with arrows respecting the marking and with transport by pullback. Then $\mathcal F_y$ is a predeformation category satisfying (RS), in the sense of that definition. Its tangent space $T_y=\overline{\mathcal F_y}(k[\epsilon])$ has the canonical $k$-vector structure of [lem-sfb-artin-rs-tangent-tensor]. Let $l/k$ be any finite field extension (finite-dimensional as a $k$-vector space), and put $y_l=y|_l$. The same assertions hold for $\mathcal F_{y_l}$ on $\mathcal C_{R,l}$. Pullback along $k[\epsilon]\to l[\epsilon]$ induces a $k$-linear map $\rho:T_y\to T_{y_l}$, and the map $T_y\otimes_k l\to T_{y_l}$, $v\otimes a\mapsto a\rho(v)$, is a canonical $l$-linear isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. The canonical operations are zero from the constant object, scalar multiplication from $\epsilon\mapsto a\epsilon$, and addition from the product comparison for the square-zero algebra $k[\epsilon_1,\epsilon_2]/(\epsilon_1,\epsilon_2)^2$ and the map $\epsilon_1,\epsilon_2\mapsto\epsilon$ (and likewise over $l$). No finite-dimensionality assumption on $T_y$, and no algebraicity, separation, or finite type assumption on $\mathcal Y$, is imposed.

source.place: Tags 07WU (lemma-deformation-category) and 07WX (lemma-change-of-field), together with formal-defos.tex Tag 07WB (lemma-tangent-space-change-of-field); marked category equation-predeformation-category. Affine Noetherian specialization.

proof.text: Pullback sends a marked object $(\eta,\alpha)$ over $A$ to its pullback over $A'$, with the marking composed with the pullback comparison. The identity and composition constraints are those of $\mathcal Y$, so they obey the required coherence. Over $k$, the object $(y,\mathrm{id})$ exists, and between $(\eta,\alpha)$ and $(\eta',\alpha')$ the unique marking-preserving arrow is $(\alpha')^{-1}\alpha$. Thus $\mathcal F_y(k)$ is equivalent to the one-object, one-arrow groupoid. This proves precisely the predeformation conditions of [def-sfb-artin-deformation-test-category].

For $A_1\to A\leftarrow A_2$ in $\mathcal C_{R,k}$ with the second map surjective, [lem-sfb-artin-local-test-algebra] makes $P=A_1\times_A A_2$ an Artinian local $R$-algebra with residue field $k$. Its cited nilpotence assertion makes the kernel of $A_2\to A$, which lies in $\mathfrak m_{A_2}$, nilpotent. By [lem-sfb-artinian-finite-type-residue-criterion], all four rings are of finite type over $R$. The scheme pushout is $\operatorname{Spec}P$ by [lem-sfb-affine-closed-pinching-pushout], applied with the surjection $A_2\to A$ and the map $A_1\to A$. Consequently the assumed equivalence for $\mathcal Y$ applies to exactly this square.

Take a triple of marked objects over $A_1,A_2$ and a marking-preserving isomorphism over $A$. Essential surjectivity of the equivalence in step 2 glues their underlying objects to $\eta$ over $P$, with compatible restriction isomorphisms. Restrict either isomorphism to $k$ and compose with its marking to obtain $\alpha:\eta|_k\cong y$; compatibility of the given isomorphism over $A$ makes the two choices equal. For arrows between two such triples, full faithfulness gives a unique arrow over $P$; restriction to $k$ shows it respects $\alpha$. Thus restriction on marked groupoids is essentially surjective and fully faithful, proving (RS) in [def-sfb-artin-deformation-test-category]. This uses the assumed equivalence, not descent for a topology. A finite $k$-basis of $l$ generates $l$ as a $k$-algebra, so adjoining that basis to a finite set of $R$-algebra generators of $k$ proves that $l$ is of finite type over $R$. Steps 1–3 therefore apply verbatim to $y_l$ over $l$.

Apply [lem-sfb-artin-rs-tangent-tensor] to the two predeformation categories now proved to satisfy (RS). It gives their vector structures and natural bijections on square-zero extensions. Their operations have the stated form: $k[0]=k$ gives the zero class, $(a,v)\mapsto(a,cv)$ gives scalar multiplication, and the projections from $k[k\oplus k]=k[k]\times_k k[k]$ give the product comparison. The sum map $(u,v)\mapsto u+v$ then gives addition; the same argument works over $l$. Pullback $k[V]\to l[l\otimes_k V]$, $(c,v)\mapsto(c,1\otimes v)$ commutes with these projections, the sum map, the zero map and multiplication by each $c\in k$. Applied to $V=k$ and $V=k\oplus k$, these commutative diagrams show that the pullback map $\rho$ preserves zero, addition and $k$-scalars. Hence $\rho$ is $k$-linear.

For $B\in\mathcal C_{R,l}$ set $C=B\times_l k$, with its induced $R$-structure. By [lem-sfb-artinian-finite-residue-restriction], $C$ is Artinian local with residue field $k$. By [lem-sfb-artinian-finite-type-residue-criterion], both $B$ and $C$ are of finite type over $R$. The kernel of $B\to l$ is nilpotent by [lem-weil-pbc-artinian-local-noetherian-nilpotent]. By [lem-sfb-affine-closed-pinching-pushout], $\operatorname{Spec}C=\operatorname{Spec}k\amalg_{\operatorname{Spec}l}\operatorname{Spec}B$. The hypothesis on $\mathcal Y$ therefore identifies $\mathcal Y(C)$ with triples $(z,\eta,\gamma:z|_l\cong\eta|_l)$ for $z\in\mathcal Y(k)$ and $\eta\in\mathcal Y(B)$. An object marked by $\alpha:z\cong y$ gives the marking $\eta|_l\xrightarrow{\gamma^{-1}}z|_l\xrightarrow{\alpha|_l}y_l$. Conversely a marking $\beta:\eta|_l\cong y_l$ gives the triple $(y,\eta,\beta^{-1})$. The isomorphism $\alpha:z\cong y$ identifies the resulting triple with the original one, and arrows are exactly the marking-preserving arrows on both sides. Thus pullback is an equivalence $\mathcal F_y(C)\simeq\mathcal F_{y_l}(B)$. It is natural in $B$, since the maps $B\times_l k\to B$ commute with every residue-preserving $B\to B'$ and pullback composition has the given coherent comparisons.

proof.text: Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional $l$-vector space and write $V_k$ for its underlying $k$-vector space. It is finite-dimensional because $[l:k]<\infty$. Directly, $l[V]\times_l k=k[V_k]$, by $((c,v),t)\mapsto(t,v)$, since the fibre-product condition is $c=t$. Step 5 and [lem-sfb-artin-rs-tangent-tensor] now give a natural bijection $b_V:T_y\otimes_k V_k\longrightarrow\overline{\mathcal F_{y_l}}(l[V])$. These bijections preserve zero and addition: the projections and sum for $V\oplus V$ are the same underlying $k$-linear maps and the same square-zero ring maps on both sides. For $a\in l$, multiplication $m_a:V\to V$ is $k$-linear. Naturality identifies its action on the source with $1\otimes m_a$ and on the target with transport along $(c,v)\mapsto(c,av)$. At $V=l$ this target action is precisely $a$ times the tangent class, by step 4. Consequently $b_l:T_y\otimes_k l\to T_{y_l}$ is an $l$-linear bijection. Naturality for $k\to l$, $1\mapsto1$, identifies $b_l(v\otimes1)$ with pullback along $k[\epsilon]\to k[l\epsilon]\to l[\epsilon]$, namely $\rho(v)$. Therefore $b_l(v\otimes a)=a\rho(v)$. This description makes it canonical and independent of all pullback choices up to the coherent isomorphisms, which disappear on isomorphism classes. Only the auxiliary space $V_k$, never $T_y$, was required finite-dimensional.

lean.statement: theorem markedDeformation_tangent_field_extension (F : BasedCategory.{v, w} (Over (Spec (.of R)))) (hF : IsFibredInGroupoids F) (hRS : CategoryTheory.ArtinFamily.IsRimSchlessinger (.of R) F) (x : Functor.Fiber F.p (affine (CommAlgCat.of R k))) : HasMarkedPredeformation F x ∧ ∃ (_ : AddCommGroup (Tangent F x)) (_ : Module k (Tangent F x)), (∀ t : Tangent F x, IsZeroClass F x t ↔ t = 0) ∧ (∀ (c : k) (t s : Tangent F x), IsScalarClass F x c t s ↔ s = c • t) ∧ (∀ t s r : Tangent F x, IsSumClass F x t s r ↔ r = t + s) ∧ ∀ (l : Type u) [Field l] [Algebra k l] [Algebra R l] [IsScalarTower R k l] [FiniteDimensional k l] (xl : Functor.Fiber F.p (affine (CommAlgCat.of R l))) (a : xl.val ⟶ x.val), F.p.IsHomLift (affineMap (CommAlgCat.ofHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R k l))) a → ∃ (_ : Algebra.FiniteType R l), HasMarkedPredeformation F xl ∧ ∃ (_ : AddCommGroup (Tangent F xl)) (_ : Module l (Tangent F xl)) (_ : Module k (Tangent F xl)) (_ : IsScalarTower k l (Tangent F xl)), (∀ t : Tangent F xl, IsZeroClass F xl t ↔ t = 0) ∧ (∀ (c : l) (t s : Tangent F xl), IsScalarClass F xl c t s ↔ s = c • t) ∧ (∀ t s r : Tangent F xl, IsSumClass F xl t s r ↔ r = t + s) ∧ ∃ (rho : Tangent F x →ₗ[k] Tangent F xl) (e : @LinearEquiv l l _ _ (RingHom.id l) (RingHom.id l) _ _ (TensorProduct k (Tangent F x) l) (Tangent F xl) _ _ (rightTensorModule l (Tangent F x)) _), (∀ (Y : Marked F x (ArtinDeformation.squareZeroTest (R := R) (k := k) k)) (Z : Marked F xl (ArtinDeformation.squareZeroTest (R := R) (k := l) l)), PullsBackField F x l xl a Y Z → rho (classOf F x Y) = classOf F xl Z) ∧ ∀ (t : Tangent F x) (c : l), e (t ⊗ₜ[k] c) = c • rho t
